name: Blackwake Rounds
card_text: Shots gain black-electric tracers. Every 8th shot bursts into void shrapnel.
trigger: Each 8th primary shot spawned; its collision or normal expiry creates the burst.
extra_rank_scaling: +2 shards and +5 percentage points shard damage per extra rank; cap 18 physical shards per burst.
guardrails: Count only authored primary shots. Shards cannot create shards, award extra scrap, or re-trigger hit-based augment events.

name: Riftstep Surge
card_text: Dodges become short blinks. A slicing afterimage cuts through enemies.
trigger: On existing dodge-roll start, travel in chosen safe direction and leave one damaging echo.
extra_rank_scaling: +0.75 blink units and +25 slash damage per rank; collision-limited maximum 8 units.
guardrails: Do not blink through walls, outside bounds, or across bosses. Preserve Perfect Dodge detection, invulnerability window, and input controls.

name: Lootstorm Halo
card_text: Glowing diamonds orbit you, block bullets, then fire back as crystal shrapnel.
trigger: On legitimate scrap pickup, recharge an orbit gem; incoming eligible projectile consumes one gem.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 gem capacity per rank (cap 6), +8 retaliatory damage per fragment per rank.
guardrails: No duplicate currency; consuming a gem does not call scrap pickup again. Only one projectile intercepted per gem; keep independent of 14s shield recovery.

name: Emperor’s Pressure
card_text: Entering combat emits a crushing aura that stuns weak foes and cracks shields.
trigger: At combat encounter entry and no more than once each 18 combat seconds afterward.
extra_rank_scaling: +2 radius units and +0.2s normal-enemy stun per rank; control duration capped at 1.6s.
guardrails: Never interrupt boss scripting, forcibly expose boss cores, or stun elite/boss AI. Re-entry events must be deduplicated.

name: Phantom Broadside
card_text: Every primary volley is echoed by spectral pirate cannons.
trigger: Primary volleys schedule one non-recursive spectral copy after 0.12s.
extra_rank_scaling: +15 percentage points echo strength per rank; visual ghost cannons cap at four per volley.
guardrails: Echoes are secondary damage and cannot schedule more echoes. Reuse existing broadside effects without replacing original guns.

name: Voltage Crown
card_text: Weak-point hits chain teal lightning through nearby enemies.
trigger: A primary weak-point hit selects the nearest eligible unharmed chain targets.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 additional target per rank (cap 8); +5 percentage points arc damage per rank.
guardrails: No repeat target within one chain and no recursive chain triggers. Respect line-of-sight and targetability.

name: Nebula Skin
card_text: A shimmering aura shield regenerates rapidly while moving.
trigger: While ship speed exceeds 30% of normal cruise speed AND standard shield lockout has ended.
extra_rank_scaling: +0.3x regen multiplier per rank; do not grant instant shield capacity or lockout bypass.
guardrails: The existing 14-second shield recovery delay remains authoritative; damage resets that countdown as before.

name: Dreadwake Engine
card_text: Kill chains trigger brutal speed bursts and damaging wake trails.
trigger: Four confirmed unique enemy kills within a sliding 5-second combat window.
extra_rank_scaling: +10 percentage points speed and +10 wake DPS per rank; duration capped at 5s.
guardrails: Internal 8s cooldown. Wake damage does not refresh the same kill chain recursively. Avoid overlap with the existing trail system.

name: Predator’s Gaze
card_text: Aimed targets are marked and suffer bonus critical damage.
trigger: Aim/lock remains on one target for 0.4 seconds; applies a four-second mark.
extra_rank_scaling: +5 critical-chance points and +0.15x critical multiplier per rank; chance capped at 100%.
guardrails: Bosses/weak points remain targetable only in existing valid windows; marking does not bypass exposure mechanics.

name: Scrap Typhoon
card_text: Collected scrap spins around you as a slicing storm.
trigger: Each real scrap pickup energizes one spinning scrap blade for six combat seconds.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 blade per rank (cap 8) and +8 damage per blade per rank.
guardrails: No phantom scrap currency. Use one pickup transaction, no secondary scrap duplication or repeated target damage per frame.

name: Conqueror’s Circuit
card_text: Perfect dodges unleash black-lightning shockwaves and slow everything nearby.
trigger: Verified Perfect Dodge resolution; never a regular or failed dodge.
extra_rank_scaling: +70 shockwave damage and +2 radius units per rank; keep projectile slow floor at 20% normal speed.
guardrails: Use gameplay dt; bosses may take damage but their phases/timers and the escape clock must not be frozen.

name: Leviathan Pulse
card_text: Secondary fire becomes a gigantic expanding teal-purple energy ring.
trigger: Valid secondary-fire activation using the existing weapon input and energy rules.
extra_rank_scaling: +2 ring radius and +100 hit damage per extra rank; maintain weapon trigger/cost semantics.
guardrails: Do not disable or replace secondary fire, remove its cooldown, or damage a target every animation frame.

name: Starbreaker Choir
card_text: Drone shots harmonize into a piercing beam chorus.
trigger: Every 4 combat seconds while player is firing; sync existing orbitals or conjure two nonpersistent ghost drones.
extra_rank_scaling: +130 beam DPS per rank; visual emitters cap at 4; interval stays 4s.
guardrails: Always works even if the player has not picked Ghost Fleet. Beam tick damage must be frame-rate independent.

name: Rift Sovereign
card_text: Activating an augment spawns a temporary throne field with huge fire-rate and defense boosts.
trigger: Selecting any augment arms a field that activates on resumption of the next combat state.
extra_rank_scaling: +2 field seconds and +15 percentage points fire rate per extra rank; damage reduction max 65%.
guardrails: Augments are currently passive picks, not hotbar abilities: use upgrade pick/onPick and defer clock until gameplay resumes. Do not decrement while choosing.

name: Eclipse Arsenal
card_text: Weapons auto-cycle through plasma, void blades, rail shots, and crystal missiles.
trigger: Every three combat seconds while actively attacking, emit one additional special volley type in repeating order.
extra_rank_scaling: +70 total volley damage per rank; active weapon loadout remains intact.
guardrails: Never replace or suppress any of the existing simultaneous weapons. Bonus volley cannot itself trigger other special cycles.

name: Throne of Thunder
card_text: Standing your ground builds a storm crown that calls down bolts.
trigger: Remain under 40% move speed for 1.2 combat seconds; activates an electrical crown for 6s.
extra_rank_scaling: +55 damage per rank and +1s active duration per rank; storm active duration cap 9s.
guardrails: An 8s cooldown starts on storm end; repositioning does not force existing player movement rules to change.

name: Void Dominion
card_text: Kills extend a fear aura that weakens enemy fire and drags foes inward.
trigger: On unique enemy kill: extend a three-second aura, capped at 8s remaining.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 radius and +5 percentage points shot damage reduction per rank; reduction capped at 60%.
guardrails: Do not pull invulnerable or phase-locked bosses. Kills caused by the aura may damage but cannot recursively generate aura extensions without unique primary kill credit.

name: Overlord’s Reflex
card_text: After taking a hit, time nearly stops and you phase through danger briefly.
trigger: First legitimate shield/hull damage after a 25s combat cooldown.
extra_rank_scaling: +0.20s slow duration and +0.12s phase duration per rank; phase cap 1.5s.
guardrails: Do not slow music, input, boss narrative clocks, or final escape deadline. Respect existing damage/phase state and no self-trigger loops.

name: Diamond Apocalypse
card_text: Loot crystals duplicate and detonate in violent chain reactions.
trigger: Each tenth genuine scrap pickup spawns visually duplicated NON-CURRENCY crystal bombs.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 illusion crystal per rank (cap 7) and +60 blast damage per rank.
guardrails: Never award bonus scrap, score, pickups or currency from the duplicates. Max 7 detonations per burst; blast kills cannot generate fresh crystal duplication.

name: Black Flag Ascension
card_text: Low health triggers a terrifying aura, lifesteal, and extreme attack speed.
trigger: On crossing below 30% max hull during combat, if not already activated and 35s cooldown elapsed.
extra_rank_scaling: +15 percentage points fire rate, +1% lifesteal and +3 HP/sec cap per rank.
guardrails: Does not disable shield lockout or grant extra revives. Do not trigger repeatedly on the same low-health threshold.

name: Emperor of the Rift
card_text: Unleash a domination wave that deletes lesser enemies and exposes boss cores.
trigger: First valid combat entry after pick; then every 35 combat seconds while fighting.
extra_rank_scaling: +4 radius and +180 elite damage per rank; boss vulnerability duration remains 2s.
guardrails: Never bypass boss invulnerability, skip scripted phases, delete elites/bosses, or expose nonexistent cores; fallback to stagger pulse if boss core is protected.

name: Godspeed Marauder
card_text: Movement becomes hyper-fast dashes with electric clones that attack on their own.
trigger: While boosting, move faster; on every valid dodge, leave combat clones for 2s.
extra_rank_scaling: +10 percentage points movement bonus and +1 clone per rank, cap 5 active clones.
guardrails: Do not pass through blockers or trivialize final escape countdown. Clones cannot spawn their own clones or credit duplicate kills.

name: Singularity Palace
card_text: A rotating black-hole fortress devours bullets and crushes nearby enemies.
trigger: On every 16th unique combat kill; spawn one rotating field for up to 12s.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 radius and +35 DPS per rank; one instance maximum, 16s cooldown after termination.
guardrails: Do not absorb mission-critical scripted objects or pull bosses out of arenas. Bullet suppression uses capped budget and nonrecursive effects.

name: Celestial Execution
card_text: Every 12th hit summons a colossal descending energy blade.
trigger: Every 12th registered direct player primary hit on a valid target.
extra_rank_scaling: +200 blade damage and +1 blast radius per rank; maximum one active blade visual.
guardrails: Do not count the blade’s own damage as a primary hit, or penetrate protected boss phases. Debounce target hits per swordfall.

name: King’s Cataclysm
card_text: Trigger a devastating blast of black lightning, rift fire, and diamond shards.
trigger: On first transition to Infernal-or-hotter Rift Heat, with 20s internal combat cooldown.
extra_rank_scaling: +180 radial damage and +4 bolt count per rank; cap 24 bolts.
guardrails: Do not repeatedly trigger when Heat stays high. Do not permit shard or blast damage to restart explosion cascades.

name: Infinite Armada
card_text: Summon ghost pirate frigates that broadside the battlefield.
trigger: At boss encounter entry or 10 unique kills in a normal encounter; no more than once per 24s.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 frigate per rank (cap 5), +25 damage per broadside per rank.
guardrails: Summon is event- and cooldown-controlled; do not duplicate on boss phase transitions or turn ghost ships into persistent save entities.

name: End of Fear
card_text: Near death becomes invulnerability followed by a terrifying aura burst.
trigger: First eligible lethal hit per encounter (after existing Death Warrant rescue priority), or crossing below 15% hull.
extra_rank_scaling: +0.25s phase and +180 wave damage per rank; invulnerability cap 4s.
guardrails: One activation per encounter. Preserve existing one-time lethal rescues, score finalization, and final escape timeout; never grants a free victory.

name: Storm Tyrant Halo
card_text: A permanent halo emits arcs, mini-beams, and orbiting storm spears.
trigger: Passive during combat while rank is installed.
extra_rank_scaling: +1 spear per rank (cap 8), +25 spear damage and +70 beam damage per rank.
guardrails: Limit to eight physical spears, per-target contact cooldown and fixed-time beam strikes. Do not count halo damage as primary shots.

name: Crown of the Last Pirate
card_text: All augments are amplified and gain extra empowered effects.
trigger: Global post-aggregation enhancement when other installed augment effects resolve.
extra_rank_scaling: +10 percentage points amplification per rank, cap +150% combined. Bonus pulses throttle to one per second globally.
guardrails: No amplification of base stats, the crown’s own amplifier, saved progress, event counts, cooldown reduction, or infinite self-recursion. Only tagged augment magnitude fields.

name: Absolute Overcharge
card_text: Heat overflows into god-mode: wider beams, no weapon cooldowns, multiplied damage.
trigger: Entering Infernal-or-hotter Heat with 22s combat cooldown; empower for 6s.
extra_rank_scaling: +0.4x damage multiplier and +0.6s duration per rank; duration caps at 10s.
guardrails: Never remove dodge, recovery, boss, music, escape, or global scheduler cooldowns. Hard limit emission per frame and keep all damage finite.
